title: Deck
description: A deck: what a `.deck` file holds.

id.description: `d-` and random characters.

Size.description: Width and height in slide units (1/96 inch).

master.description: Elements drawn on every slide, under its own: a header bar, a logo, a slide number.

dimmedOpacity.description: Opacity of a dimmed element, 0 to 1.

newSlideLayout.description:
The layout a new slide starts from when the person asked for "my default layout"; the
blank layout when absent or when the deck has no layout of that name.

Colors.description: The twelve colours a theme names. They map one for one to PPTX theme colours.

FontSpec.description: A typeface and what to fall back on when it is missing.

TextStyle.description: One of the named looks for text: `title`, `subtitle`, `body`, `caption`, `code`, `citation`.

name.description: The name a slide refers to: `title`, `title-body`, `two-columns`, ...

hideMaster.description: Leave out the master elements on slides of this layout.

elements.description:
Shapes, pictures and words drawn on every slide of this layout, under the slide's own
elements and over the master's: the decoration of a layout a person designed. Not
selectable on a slide; changing them changes every slide that uses the layout.

background.description: What fills a slide of this layout behind its elements, when the slide has none of its own.

PlaceholderDef.description: A slot on a layout that an element can fill.

style.description: The text style it starts from.

list.description: Set as a list when filled.

prompt.description: What the empty slot asks for, such as "Click to add title".

Style.description: Everything about an element's looks that is not its text.

radius.description: Corner radius of a rounded shape, in slide units.

Shadow.description: A soft shadow behind an element.

StepState.description: How an element looks from a step onward, until the next change.

oneOf.description: Not shown.
Shown faded, at the theme's dimmed opacity.
As styled.
As styled, with the theme's highlight around it.

PageSource.description: A page of the host that an element was made from or points at.

page.description: The page, as the host names pages (a vault path in Kasten, such as `projects/talk/plan.md`).

id.description: How the page is told apart from others when the host has a stable name for it, so a moved page is found again.

title.description: What the page was called when it was read.

icon.description: The page's icon (a glyph or an emoji) when it was read.

section.description: The heading whose section it is; the whole page when absent.

sync.description: Kept in step with the page: "Update from page" is on offer, and the host says when the page has changed.

hash.description: A fingerprint of the Markdown it was made from, to tell whether the page has changed since.

markdown.description: The Markdown of the page (or of the section) as it was read: what an embedded page is drawn from where the page cannot be read.

SourceKind.description: What an element is of the page it came from.

oneOf.description: A read-only view of the page, drawn from its Markdown (`markdown`).
The words and pictures of the whole page, made into elements of the slide.
The words and pictures of one section of the page (`section`), made into elements.
A link to the page, as words or as a card.

Text.description: The text of a text box, a shape, a table cell or a label.

fit.description: What the box does when the words do not fit; they run past the edge when absent.

wrap.description: `false` keeps every paragraph on one line instead of wrapping at the box's edge.

Paragraph.description: A paragraph: runs and how they are set.

level.description: Indent level of a list item, from 0.

style.description:
The theme text style the paragraph starts from: `title`,
`subtitle`, `body`, `caption`, `code` or `citation`.

lineSpacing.description: A multiple of the line height, such as 1.15.

step.description: The step at which this paragraph appears, for lists that build line by line.

listStyle.description: How the marker of a list item looks; the level's own when absent.

start.description:
The number a numbered item begins counting at: it starts a run of its own
even when numbered items come before it ("restart numbering", or a run
that goes on after something else, "continue the previous list").

bulletColor.description: The marker's colour, a theme token or `#rrggbb`; the first words' own when absent.

bulletSize.description:
The marker's size as a multiple of the words' size, 0.25 to 4 (25% to 400%); 1 when absent.
An empty paragraph's words are the one empty run it holds, whose size, colour and other
settings are the paragraph's mark: they decide how large its marker and its line are.

marginLeft.description:
Where the lines after the first start, in slide units from the box's inset. The
list level decides when absent.

indent.description:
Where the first line starts, in slide units from `margin_left`; negative hangs it
out to the left, as a list marker does. The marker's room decides when absent.

Run.description: A stretch of text with one look.

color.description: A theme token or `#rrggbb`; the paragraph's style when absent.

link.description: A web address, `slide:<id>` for a link to a slide, or `page:<path>` (then `#` and a heading) for a link to a page of the host.

code.description: Inline code: drawn in the code font.

field.description: A field the text stands for, such as `slideNumber`; `t` is its sample.

script.description: Raised (superscript) or lowered (subscript) and set smaller.

smallCaps.description: Lower-case letters drawn as small capitals.

allCaps.description: Every letter drawn as a capital; the words themselves are not changed.

spacing.description: Extra space between letters, in points; negative tightens.

Script.description: Raised or lowered text, set smaller as in a footnote mark or a power.

ListStyle.description:
How the marker in front of a list item looks: a glyph for a bullet list, a
counting scheme for a numbered one. The paragraph's `list` says which kind of
list it is; a style of the other kind is ignored and the level's own is used.

oneOf.description: ● (the first level of a bullet list).
○ (the second level).
■ (the third level).
1. 2. 3. (the first level of a numbered list).
a. b. c. (the second level).
A. B. C.
i. ii. iii. (the third level).
I. II. III.

Insets.description: Space between a box's edge and its text, in slide units.

TextFit.description: What a text box does when its words do not fit it.

oneOf.description: The words run past the edge of the box (the default).
The type is set smaller, to a floor, until the words fit.
The box grows or shrinks in height to fit its words.
